**CIDOB political biography — Andrés Manuel López Obrador — BOOK-013 routing**

| chunk_id | decision | applicable_lens | exclusion_reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| U0001 | **EXCLUDE** | — | Navigation chrome, boilerplate publisher header, and basic biographic identifier. Provides ruler name, birth date, party affiliation, mandate dates, and successor name — all biographical scaffolding with no material economic policy content. Adjacent context for identification; no independent evidence test. |
| U0002 | **EXCLUDE** | — | Narrative political history covering charisma, electoral failures, 2018 victory margin (53.2%), PRD background, videoescándalo, desafuero 2005. Contains electoral data but no economic policy actions, fiscal measures, institutional reforms, or distributional outcomes. Topic-adjacent biographical context. |
| U0003 | **EXCLUDE** | — | Account of 2006 election dispute, autoproclamation as "presidente legítimo," civil-disobedience campaign. Electoral contestation narrative; no economic policy content. |
| U0004 | **EXCLUDE** | — | 2012 defeat, party rupture, founding of MORENA, opposition to EPN's structural reforms (energy, education, labor, telecoms), critique of narco-violence and basic-needs costs. Political opposition framing; critique mentions policy areas but does not attribute enacted policy, measured outcome, cost, or implementation finding to the ruler. |
| U0005 | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.6, 5B.9 | Lists concrete electoral program commitments: "austeridad republicana" to reorient public resources from current expenditure to investment without raising taxes; combatting poverty and elevating human development of vulnerable groups; increasing domestic gasoline supply to reduce imports and lower prices; energy and food self-sufficiency with guaranteed prices for local producers; eradicating political corruption by example. These are stated policy intentions and resource-allocation directions bearing on 5B.1 (prosperity vs. rents), 5B.6 (budget execution), and 5B.9 (shock response). Cites multiple applicable lenses. |
| U0006 | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.4 | States pragmatic social-democracy platform explicitly assuming "ortodoxas del libre mercado, la estabilidad macroeconómica, la disciplina presupuestaria y la flotación del peso" alongside rejection of privatization and priority for national production. Mentions promise to not privatize Pemex, promise of justice without vengeance regarding ex-presidents, and more conservative stance on abortion/marriage. The explicit commitment to macroeconomic discipline, budget discipline, peso flotation, and rejection of privatization of strategic sectors (5B.3, 5B.4, 5B.1) constitutes stated economic-rule/regulatory policy. |
| U0007 | **EXCLUDE** | — | Treats USMCA trade deal, migration caravans, border tensions, visa offers, Trump border-closure threat. Trade and migration context; does not attribute policy outcome, cost, or distributional result to the ruler's economic governance. |
| U0008 | **EXCLUDE** | — | Table of contents and early biographical section on childhood, family, 1969 tragedy, relocation. Personal biographical history; no economic policy content. |
| U0009 | **EXCLUDE** | — | Early political career: 1972 enrollment UNAM, 1976 first proselite activity, 1977 introduction to governor. Political socialization narrative; no economic policy content. |
| U0010 | **INCLUDE** | 5B.2 | Describes 1978 COPLAMAR delegation involving publication in indigenous languages and agricultural support programs, and teaching sociology/pedagogy at Universidad Autónoma de Tabasco. Also documents 1982 CEPES directorship and 1983 appointment as PRI state committee president under Governor González Pedrero. The party-positioning and direct appointment mechanisms described bear on 5B.2 (appointment processes, loyalty vs. performance in staffing) — a concrete example of how positions were filled through political-loyalty networks rather than open professional processes. |

**Summary: 3 included (U0005, U0006, U0010), 7 excluded.**
